minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, January 15, 2020
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, January 15, 2020.
  Members present: Bette Donovan, Lorraine Missick, Terry Kistler, Scott Snider, and
  George Borst.
  Members Absent: Chick Campo
  Staff Present: Bill Aguirre, Staff Liason, Yvonne Duran, Recreation Coordinator, and
  Brandon Granillo, Recreation Coordinator
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, November
  20, 2019 meeting, motion carried.

  Unfinished Business
2. Nutrition Program: The average meals for December was 39.

3. Guest Speaker: None.

4. Bingo Report: November – Average players per session 54. Beginning balance was
  $2,501.63, ending balance was $3,166.64, and change was $665.01. Expenses paid
  by check, $149.99 to Bingo West. $5.00 Bank Fee. Total $154.99.
  December – Average player per session 57. Beginning balance was $3,166.00.
  Ending balance was $2,945.00 and change was $220.00. Expenses paid by check
  $95.00. Bingo Bugle, $120.90 to Bingo West. $350.00 for staff/volunteers. $5.00
  Bank Fee. Total was $570.90.
  Some people attended from Glendora in January. Some people were asked about
  what the problems are in attendance. They said they get bored. Bingo planning on
  starting a new program. Changes on special payouts have saved around $7,000.00
  per year. Currently, down around $125 per month. Will start paying hall fee again in
  January.

5. Meals on Wheels: Delivered to 44 recipients for the month of November for a total of
  729 meals. Delivered to 43 recipients in December for a total of 720 meals.

6. Account Balance: $3,482.30 – Divided into two programs.
 7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: December. – Bridge has not paid. All other
  programs have paid.

8. Community Senior Services (Aging Next): No Report.

9. Mt. SAC Classes: Classes just started and are going well.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Monday, January 20th – Center closed in observance of Martin Luther King Jr. Day
  Thursday, February 13th – City Sponsored Lunch (Valentine’s theme), 11:30 AM
  Monday, February 17th – Center closed in observance of Presidents’ Day
  Tuesday, February 25th – Line Dancing Event, 1:00 – 3:00 PM.

11. Senior Advisory Committee Applications: One application has been submitted.

12. Facilities Report: Craft Room is still on hold because of rainy season. Edison did an
  assessment of the lighting at the Community Center. Will change to LED lights in the
  future.

13. Public Comments: Bill talked about the elections coming up in March. On Thursday,
  February 13th there will be a “Meet the Candidates” Forum at 6:00 PM at the
  Community Center. La Verne TV (LVTV) will record the candidates. It may be live
  streamed.

  Brandon announced that the volunteer luncheon will be held at the end of May. We
  have one nominee so far, Diane Victor. Deadline to nominate someone to be
  recognized as Volunteer of the year is Wednesday, February 19 th.

  Yvonne delivered an update on the Heritage Park restrooms. They are currently
  being updated and given a paint job.

  Scott reported that the Good Samaritan Dinner will be on Friday, February 7 th at the
  Candlelight Pavilion in Claremont. The dinner acts as a fundraiser where proceeds
  go towards Hillcrest’s Good Samaritan Program.

  George spoke about the Golf Tournament held at San Dimas Canyon. It was a
  successful tournament overall. His team won. Averages of 20 people have been
  attending the Golf Tournaments. Coyotes have been spotted while out playing.
 14. Adjourn: A motion was made to adjourn the meeting, motion approved and carried.
  The meeting was adjourned at 11:00 AM. Next meeting will be held Wednesday,
  February 19th at 10:00 AM.
